schools.name: Portland

notable_coaches.name: Luke Pohl
notable_coaches.notes: Portland head coach 2023-24 (15-7) and 2024-25 (22-3, 13-1 CAAC White per MaxPreps). Called a 'future Hall of Fame coach' when Chad Sayen was named his successor in June 2026. Portland won a 2026 district title (64-39 over Ionia) and lost a D2 regional semifinal to Freeland 61-47.

notable_coaches.name: Steve Eklund
notable_coaches.notes: Longest recent tenure on MaxPreps' coach list; 16-7 in 2006-07 and 16-8 in 2012-13.

notable_coaches.name: Chad Sayen
notable_coaches.notes: Named varsity head coach June 2026; previously a Portland assistant for 5 years.

uncertain: No state final or semifinal appearances found. The MHSAA past-champions list's only Portland entry is Portland St. Patrick (1956 Class D runner-up). michigan-football.com's deepest Portland run is a 1951 Class C quarterfinal loss to Stanton, 42-45 (its only regional title).

michigan-football.com lists district titles in 1960, 1966, 1973, 1974, 1975, 1995 (summary says 7 but only 6 are listed) plus 2026 per the Portland Beacon; the site's data looks incomplete for recent years.
Pohl's exact start year is inferred from MaxPreps (first listed 2023-24). MaxPreps leaves 2024-25 and 2025-26 blank, but the Portland Beacon names Pohl as coach in Feb 2025.
Color hex values are approximations of 'Cardinal Red & White'.

schools.name: Charlotte

notable_players.name: Eric Menk
notable_players.accolades: Lake Superior State: 1,800 points and 735 rebounds; 1996 GLIAC Player of the Year and Tournament MVP; 3x All-GLIAC; LSSU Athletic Hall of Fame (2024). Pro: 2004-05 PBA MVP, 4 PBA titles, named one of the PBA's 40 Greatest Players, 3x PBL MVP, Philippine national team (2002 Asian Games, 2007 FIBA Asia).

uncertain: No state final or semifinal appearances found; Charlotte doesn't appear on the MHSAA past-champions list. Its deepest run on michigan-football.com is the 1986 Class B quarterfinal, lost to Flint Beecher 66-73 after a 75-54 regional final win over Ionia (its only regional title).
michigan-football.com district titles: 1952, 1953, 1957, 1970, 1977, 1978, 1987, 1996, 2011, 2015 (the summary says 11; 10 are listed).
Division 2 is inferred from the CAAC listing (enrollment 638, Class B) and Portland (611) being Division 2 on MaxPreps; not directly confirmed for Charlotte.
Eric Menk's Charlotte HS attendance (1988-92) comes from Wikipedia; the LSSU bio doesn't name his high school. The grad year 1992 is inferred.
No coaches verified (MaxPreps history page was not fetchable).
